LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringFlow.label: Spring Flow
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringFlow.description: Spend 1 Flower Decree to summon a spring at the target point, briefly healing allies in range and applying Spring Flow Baptism; enemies caught in the spring steadily accumulate abnormal effects. Lasts 15 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LunarMirror.label: Lunar Mirror
LanguageData.MX_QH_LunarMirror.description: Spend 2 Flower Decree to summon a snow-like shield at the target point, briefly intercepting hostile projectiles that cross its boundary and answering each interception with a retaliating frost bullet. The shield lasts 20 seconds and absorbs up to 300 damage.
LanguageData.MX_QH_IllusoryReflection.label: Illusory Reflection
LanguageData.MX_QH_IllusoryReflection.description: Raise the blade in the chosen direction and enter a 5-second defensive stance. If attacked during the stance, negate the blow and immediately spend Sword Pressure to unleash a powerful counter toward the target; it works even without Sword Pressure, but the slash is greatly weakened.\n\n—Flowers in the mirror, the moon on the water: naught but a dream.
LanguageData.MX_QH_AscentSlash.label: Finishing Sword: Falling Blossoms
LanguageData.MX_QH_AscentSlash.description: Dash rapidly in the chosen direction, dealing minor kick damage to the first target struck. If the kick hits a hostile unit or building, leap into the air and use the momentum to consume all Sword Pressure for a powerful series of slashes. The technique can still be used with less than 1 full point of Sword Pressure, but its slash count and power are greatly reduced.\n\n"Hm... You think you've seen this move somewhere before? Maybe. Wait, I'm not that... What do you mean by 'shrimp-head'?"
